career_ladder.note: Assistant Engineers in Bangalore Electricity Supply Company Limited (BESCOM) advance through the power distribution engineering executive cadre based on performance appraisals, departmental promotion examinations, and service seniority.

steps.source_label: KPTCL / ESCOMs Employment Notification No. KPTCL/B16/21723/2021-22 and Revised Board Pay Scales

steps.designation: Executive Engineer (EE / Division Head - Bengaluru Urban / Rural)
Superintending Engineer (SE / Circle In-charge - BMAZ / BRAZ)
Chief Engineer (CE / Electricity - Zonal Operation & Maintenance)

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted via a joint competitive process administered by KPTCL for BESCOM and sibling ESCOMs, comprising a qualifying Kannada Language Test (for non-exempt candidates) followed by an OMR-based online/offline Aptitude Test of 100 marks covering engineering degree curriculum and general aptitude.

stages.source_label: KPTCL / ESCOMs Detailed Employment Notification (Kannada Test Regulations)

papers.qualifying_threshold: 35% (50 marks out of 150; exempted for candidates who passed SSLC or higher with Kannada as first or second language)

stages.source_label: KPTCL / BESCOM Examination Scheme & Marks Distribution

papers.paper_name: Core Engineering Degree Syllabus (Electrical & Electronics / Civil B.E./B.Tech curriculum)
General Awareness & Aptitude (Logical Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, General Knowledge)

stages.source_label: BESCOM Verification and Medical Fitness Regulations

papers.paper_name: Scrutiny of Original Engineering Degree, Marks Transcripts, and Reservation Testimonials

financial_package.note: Salary computed as per KPTCL / ESCOMs Board Revised Pay Scales (Scale ₹41,130–₹72,920; Entry Basic Pay ₹41,130). In-hand estimate applies mandatory project constant 58% DA as of 2025-07-01 and Bengaluru metro HRA at 27%.
financial_package.pay_source_label: KPTCL / ESCOM Notification No. KPTCL/B16/21723/2021-22 and Board Pay Scales
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated with Entry Basic Pay of ₹41,130 at mandatory 58% DA (₹23,855) plus 27% HRA in Bengaluru urban jurisdiction (₹11,105) and engineering field allowances, less statutory Contributory Pension / NPS (10% Basic+DA), Group Insurance, and professional tax deductions.
official_perks: House Rent Allowance (HRA) at 27% across Bengaluru Metropolitan Area (BBMP)
Medical reimbursement under BESCOM Medical Attendance Rules
Contributory Pension Scheme (NPS) with employer matching contribution
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) across Karnataka and India

competition_benchmarks.note: Applicant and vacancy figures verified directly from the combined KPTCL & ESCOMs Joint Recruitment Notification and Final Selection Lists.

years.selectivity_ratio: approx. 1 in 222 (calculated: applicants ÷ total notified vacancies)
years.source_label: KPTCL & ESCOMs Joint Recruitment (Advt. No. KPTCL/B16/21723/2021-22): 533 total Assistant Engineer posts (AE Electrical: 505 [393 NKK + 6 Backlog + 106 KK]; AE Civil: 28 [21 NKK + 7 KK]) serving KPTCL and BESCOM distribution areas.
